test_locate_source_regular_function: test locate_source on a regular function to get its name, file path, and line number
test_locate_source_async_function: test locate_source on an async function to verify it resolves source location correctly
test_locate_source_callable_class: test locate_source on a callable class instance to resolve its class name and file path
test_locate_source_partial_args: test locate_source on a functools.partial with positional and keyword args to extract partial arguments
test_locate_source_nested_partial: test locate_source on nested functools.partial wrappers to verify args accumulate in correct order
